specification.candidate_rationale: previously documented CritPt and AA-LCR floor effects, fixed before these fits; not selected from new loading results
specification.diagnostic_sweep: all single benchmark releases; no ranking-based selection; GPQA release uses IFBench marker
specification.resampling: one global matched named-base cluster draw across four cases
specification.null: covariance-null recoloring to fitted equal-loading covariance, then whole-cluster empirical resampling

specification.absolute_screen: CFI >= .95 and multi-group RMSEA <= .08, descriptive only
